caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile pattern featuring a repeated floral motif. The background is a muted grayish-brown color densely covered with small, irregular black dot patterns. The foreground consists of several stylized flowers in various sizes, predominantly colored in shades of pink and red with yellow accents at their centers. The flowers are attached to swirling stems that branch out in various directions, interspersed with leaves. The leaves are mostly green with occasional hints of yellow and red. The floral pattern covers the entire rectangular area, and the composition is symmetric with a uniform distribution of flowers, stems, and leaves throughout the space. The drawing is bordered by a blank, off-white margin, and there is small handwritten text in the lower right corner that reads "Marie Lundell 39."
title: Calico
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
